source_refs.note: Book p. 6: 1.4.1 Graph of Exponential Function (properties to study before sketching)

blocks.text: Is chhote subtopic mein kitab humein ek tareeqa batati hai: graph banane se pehle function ko "samajh" lo, phir graph khud ban jata hai. Bilkul jaise kisi naye shehar mein jane se pehle naqsha dekh lein to raasta aasan ho jata hai. Bohat se students graph ka matlab sirf "points lagao aur jor do" samajhte hain, lekin is tarah ghalti ka khatra rehta hai: do points ke darmiyan graph kya kar raha hai, yeh points nahin batate. Properties yeh khala (gap) bhar deti hain.

Kitab kehti hai: exponential function ka graph sketch karne se pehle hum us ki woh zaroori properties parhte hain jo graph ki poori shakal aur behaviour tay karti hain. In mein domain aur range, intercepts, injectivity, monotonicity aur asymptotic behaviour shamil hain. In features ko samajh kar hum bohat se points plot kiye baghair graph ka andaza laga sakte hain. Is analysis ke baad hum chand numainda (representative) values le kar function ka hamwar (smooth) aur durust sketch banate hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Mushkil lafzon ke aasan matlab:
Domain aur range: kaun se inputs allowed hain, aur kaun se outputs milte hain.
Intercepts: graph \(x\)-axis aur \(y\)-axis ko kahan kaat ta hai.
Injectivity: kya function one-to-one hai (yani koi output do dafa nahin aata).
Monotonicity (yaksaan rawayya): kya graph sirf oopar jata hai ya sirf neeche (strictly increasing ya strictly decreasing).
Asymptotic behaviour: asymptote woh line hai jis ke graph qareeb se qareeb jata hai magar use chhoota nahin.
Yeh paanchon properties \(y = a^{x}\) ke liye 1.4.2 mein saabit ki gayi hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kisi bhi exponential graph ko banane ka hamara step-by-step plan (Examples 7 aur 8 mein yahi chalega):

items: Faisla kijiye: increasing (\(a > 1\)) ya decreasing (\(0 < a < 1\)).
Values ka chhota sa table banaiye, maslan \(x = -2, -1, 0, 1, 2\).
Points plot kar ke unhein hamwar curve se jodiye jo \(x\)-axis ke qareeb jaye magar use kabhi na chhooye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar aap ko pehle se pata ho ke graph hamesha \(x\)-axis ke oopar hai, \((0, 1)\) se guzarta hai aur sirf oopar jata hai, to kya aap ko 50 points plot karne ki zaroorat hai?
Jawab: nahin. Paanch chhe points hi kaafi hain, kyun ke shakal properties ne pehle hi bata di hai. Yahi is subtopic ka asal sabaq hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Pehle properties parhiye; yahi graph ki shakal tay karti hain.
2. Phir chand representative values durust sketch ke liye kaafi hain.
3. Paanch properties: domain aur range, intercepts, injectivity, monotonicity, asymptote.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Plot kiye hue points ko seedhi lakeeron se jor dena. Graph hamwar curve hai, tooti hui lakeer nahin.
2. Curve ko \(x\)-axis se chhoo dena ya us ke neeche le jana. \(a^{x}\) hamesha positive hai.
3. Sirf positive \(x\) values plot karna. Domain tamam real numbers hain, is liye negative \(x\) bhi dikhaiye.
